summary: Suggests a way for workstations to dynamically access mail from a mailbox server, called a repository. It was a standard for the SUMEX-AIM community and an experimental proposal for the Internet. It was replaced by RFC 1176 and RFC 1203.

eli5.summary: Instead of copying all your mail to your computer, you keep it on a server and look at it from wherever you are.

questions: how did interactive mail access begin
